add.title: Even If You Go to the Skies, We'll Find You: LGBT People in Afghanistan After the Taliban Takeover (Human Rights Watch / OutRight Action International)
add.summary: HRW/OutRight 43-page report (26 Jan 2022, 60 interviews) documents that since the Taliban takeover of 15 Aug 2021, LGBT Afghans have faced threats, assault, blackmail and wrongful-detention risk, with Taliban members using leaked personal data to pursue individuals considered gay or gender-nonconforming. Thin for the prison-housing axis: the report documents detention-related dangers for LGBT Afghans but contains no placement practice for trans prisoners - no birth-sex-vs-identity housing rule, no trans special units, and no solitary/segregation practice is described; it recommends the Taliban end discrimination and violence against LGBT people.
